senses.gloss: m. (תְּחַל) [beginning to ripen,] early ripe or half-ripe date.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 15b:10">Ḥag. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>אכל ת׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="V00185"><he>תוחלנא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="U00872"><he>שִׁיחְלָא</he></cite>; [Ms. M. <he>היינו דאמרי אינשי אשכחת תְּחַלְתָּא אכל גווא ושדי שיחלי</he> (not <he>אשכחתיה</he>) that is what people say, when thou findest an early date, eat the inside and throw away the peel (or the kernel); <he>אמרי במערבא אכול תחלא וכ׳</he> they say in the west, eat the date &c. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30)].—Pl. <he>תּוּחְלֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="V00185">next w.</cite>
